shared_elements: bearded male human figure in profile
row of repeated figures facing the same direction
low-relief carved figures with patterned detail (beards, textiles)
horizontal band of repeating small motifs (crenellation/brickwork pattern vs rosette band)
justification: Both show shallow-relief bearded male figures strictly in profile, arranged in overlapping rows all facing one direction, with a horizontal band of small repeating motifs and stacked registers, and both use similar conventions of finely patterned surface detail for hair, beard and textiles. But the depicted subjects differ fundamentally: A is a siege action with archers drawing bows against towered, crenellated fortifications and a wheeled siege engine, while B is a static file of tall-capped attendants holding flowers with no architecture, action or weaponry.
